memory.words: memory_size in infra/aws/terraform/investor-reporting/reporting-gold/lambda.tf goes from 3008 to 8192 MB, the value ruled by the CTO ROUND-123 ANALYSIS (B-49F, ruling 1) for the hop-1 reporting-gold function; the Lambda ceiling is 10240 MB. timeout stays 900 seconds. Nothing else in the function's settings changes.

headroom.words: The measured peak is the peak resident memory of the two reading functions on one filled day, round 122's record RD_STAGE_MEMORY_R122.json, read as peak_rss_mb. Its fraction of the new 8192 MB allocation is 0.4913, under the 0.7 line. The figure was measured on a workstation, not in the Lambda; the Lambda's own peak is an inference from it and is not measured here.

expected_plan.words: The plan is expected to change two resources and add and destroy none. The function changes by its code hash and by memory_size. The role policy changes by the grants of rounds 121 and 122. The bundle is built by the deploying lane at the apply, through the source map entry irpt-reporting-gold-lambda and its build script, not by this worker. Nothing was planned in this worker's run.

validated.words: This box has no Terraform binary, so no terraform validate or plan was run. The edit was checked by the issuer's checker, which reads the file as text.

words: One Terraform file changed, in one commit: memory_size 3008 to 8192 and a header comment that now records the change and this order. Nothing was planned, applied, scheduled, pushed or deployed, and no AWS call was made.
